product_one_liner.value: Aviso AI is an agentic revenue platform for go-to-market teams that unifies the lead-to-renewal lifecycle, supports forecasting, and automates revenue actions.

pricing_page.notes: A Pricing link exists, but its destination is a custom-quote request form, with no named plans or prices; treated as the bare-contact-form exception.

founded_year.notes: Uses the founding year explicitly stated in Aviso's own press release.

eng_blog.notes: Technical implementation articles exist, but the reviewed bylines do not establish two posts authored by engineers, so the specified threshold was not met.

public_docs.notes: Public help center covering accounts, deals, forecasting-related workflows, conversational intelligence, agentic workflows, and other product modules.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable US and India openings contain no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science titles. The listed Data Engineer role is excluded under the requested definition.

model_provider.notes: Aviso explicitly says it added GPT functionality; the statement does not identify a particular version or hosting provider.

compliance_certs.notes: GDPR is described as a completed assessment and compliance review. PCI DSS Service Provider Level 1 is mentioned in the AWS-hosting context, rather than as a separate Aviso certification.

last_funding.notes: Dealroom lists the month, stage, and amount; Crustdata identifies January 2022 as the latest round. Other funding profiles have incomplete histories.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round is January 2022, before the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive opening is listed for remote USA and Canada.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced its AI CSM product on June 16, 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Arun Sharma's profile dates his Aviso tenure from February 2026 and identifies him as VP of Creative; Aviso's leadership page lists the same role.
